title: Absolutely stellar replacement casting- 10/10 no notes #DeathBecomesH...
transcript: Okay, let's talk about Betsy Wolfe and death becomes her. She made her debut in the role last night, and I was there, and I am happy to report she is just as perfect as we all expected. Madeline is quite different from Megan's. She feels a lot more cold and calculated than Megan did, which is very fun because we've never really seen Betsy play a mean character. Her previous roles have all been so likable, and you can tell she is just reveling being able to play someone that is mean. With that being said, the signature style of Betsy Wolfe, comedy and delivery, is very much still present, so her performance is very much a fun mix of familiar and new. I also think her Madeline is just a little bit more cracked than Megan's, for lack of a better word. Definitely a little bit more kooky, and I felt like Jen kind of matched that energy, especially in the moments where she is mimicking Madeline. It is so funny, and I feel like their chemistry is already so strong. The two of them have been real life friends for a while, and you can definitely tell. I'm very excited to see how Betsy continues to grow in the role. She's only there until, I think, April 19th, so it's a very short run, but I do think that everyone that gets to see her is in for a real treat.
